units.source_text: 到了夏天，藤壶妃子更加不能起床了。

en.t: When summer came, Lady Fujitsubo became even less able to rise from her bed.

units.source_text: 她怀孕已有三个月，外表已可分明看出。

en.t: She was already three months pregnant, and it could now be clearly seen from her appearance.
All the ladies-in-waiting began to speak of it as well.

units.source_text: 但妃子对此意外宿缘，只觉得痛心。

en.t: But to the lady herself, this unexpected bond of fate brought only pain.

units.source_text: 别人全然不知道底细，都惊诧道：“有喜三个月了，为什么还不奏闻？”

en.t: Others knew nothing of the truth behind it and were astonished, saying, "She has been with child for three months, so why has it still not been reported to His Majesty?"

units.source_text: 此事藤壶妃子自己心中分明知道。

en.t: Lady Fujitsubo herself knew the truth of the matter perfectly well in her heart.

units.source_text: 此外只有妃子的乳母的女儿弁君，因经常服侍入浴，妃子身上一切情况她都详细知道；

en.t: Apart from her, only Ben no Kimi, the daughter of the lady's nurse, knew every detail of her bodily condition, because she often attended her at the bath;

units.source_text: 还有牵线的王命妇当然知道。

en.t: and Wang no Myobu, who had arranged the meeting, naturally knew as well.

units.source_text: 她们都觉得此事不比寻常，但也不敢互相谈论。

en.t: They both felt that this matter was far from ordinary, but they did not dare discuss it with each other.

units.source_text: 王命妇想起自己的牵线造成了这样的结果，

en.t: When Wang no Myobu thought that her own mediation had brought about this result,

units.source_text: 觉得这也是不可避免的前世宿缘，人的命运真不可知啊！

en.t: she felt that this too must be an unavoidable bond from a former life, and that human fate was truly unknowable.

units.source_text: 向宫中奏闻，只说因有妖魔侵扰，不能立刻看出怀孕征候，所以迟报。

en.t: When the matter was reported to the palace, they said only that malign spirits had interfered, so the signs of pregnancy could not be recognized at once and the report had been delayed.
Everyone outside believed this to be true.

units.source_text: 皇上知道妃子怀孕，更加无限地怜爱她了。

en.t: When the Emperor learned that the lady was pregnant, his tenderness for her grew still more boundless.
Messengers sent to inquire after her came and went without cease.

units.source_text: 藤壶妃子只是忧愁惶恐，镇日耽于沉思。

en.t: Lady Fujitsubo, however, was filled only with sorrow and fear, and spent the whole day sunk in thought.
